text:
Alex G: Quick q — can we lock a permanent evening swap checklist and escalation list? I'm heading OOO tomorrow and want handoff to be smooth.
Priya N: +1. can we do 3x/week sync or is async enough? :thinking_face:
Mateo R: async ok for routine stuff. for +sev incidents we should keep a short triage call.
Alex G: proposal: async updates daily in thread by 18:30 PST, and a 10m triage call only if there's any P1/P2 open. agenda for triage call:
```
- 1m quick status (owners)
- 3m actions for blockers
- 3m escalation needs & handoff
- 3m confirm next steps / owner
```
Jing W: I like the lightweight call. can we also list escalation contacts in the thread header so new folks know who to ping?
Mateo R: yes — put PagerDuty + secondary on the list. also add DB oncall for infra-facing incidents.
Priya N: pinging @ops-bot to attach current escalation roster? :wave:
ops-bot: Attached latest oncall roster PDF: https://redwood-internal/schedules/oncall_roster_mar2026.pdf (file uploaded)
Alex G: perfect. two more asks: 1) include code-owner or service owner in the daily status line, 2) add a short template to copy into thread when reporting an incident.
Priya N: draft template suggestion:
```
- Incident: <short title>
- Sev: P1/P2/P3
- Impact: <who/what>
- Owner: @name
- Actions taken: <short bullet list>
- Blockers/needs: <who to escalate to>
```
Jing W: sounds good. i'll update the onboarding doc with this and link it in the channel.
Mateo R: can someone add a calendar invite for the fallback triage call (we'll only accept if an incident gets flagged)? 15 min slot 18:40-18:55 PST
Alex G: i'll add the invite and set it to optional for the oncall rota. thanks everyone, i'll post the final checklist + template here before EOD. :thumbsup:
